      public static void modOutSToInHouse(int selPrtIndexInHouse, InHousePart modToInHouse)

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL url, ResourceBundle resourceBundle)
      This method initializes the fields in the In-House Modify Part screen. The fields are initialized with the selected part from the Main screen or Outsourced Modify Part screen.
      Specified by:
      initialize in interface javafx.fxml.Initializable

    • backToMain

      public void backToMain(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method is called when the Cancel button is clicked. It cancels the modify In-House part request and redirects to the main screen.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • modifyPartOutsourced

      public void modifyPartOutsourced(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method allows the user to switch to the Outsourced Modify Part screen. It takes the In-House part, converts it to an Outsourced part and then redirects to Outsourced Modify Part screen. It also has a validation check for empty fields.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • onSaveModPart

      public void onSaveModPart(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent) throws IOException
      This method saves the Modified part. It updates the modified part, validates the data entered, and redirects to the Main screen.
      Throws:
      IOException
